look_here_first: Look for opposite egg-shaped leaves and funnel-shaped evening-opening flowers, often pink/red/yellow; examine the persistent five-lobed involucre and one-seeded anthocarp fruit.
photo_note: First physical image only for provisional recognition; photo role, exact accepted taxon and Hays-area nativity still need specialist review.
identification_caution: Cultivated ornamental species; do not equate a photographed garden cultivar with wild local native plants.
